name: disasterNumber
desc: Sequentially assigned number used to designate an event or incident declared as a disaster. For more information on the disaster process visit https://www.fema.gov/disasters/how-declared

name: declarationDate
desc: Date the disaster was declared

name: incidentType
desc: Type of incident such as fire or flood. The incident type will affect the types of assistance available. For more information on incident types, please visit: https://www.fema.gov

name: pwNumber
desc: Sequentially assigned number used to identify a unique project

name: applicationTitle
desc: Standard, non-unique (free form text) application title

name: applicantId
desc: Unique Public Assistance applicant identification number

name: damageCategoryCode
desc: Code representing the type of work eligible for reimbursement through a Public Assistance grant; for a full listing of each category please go to https://www.fema.gov/assistance/public/program-overview

name: damageCategoryDescrip
desc: Damage category code related to the Damage Category Description

name: projectProcessStep
desc: The current process location of a project from formulation through closeout including pending stages, discontinuation and obligation.

name: projectSize
desc: Projects are designated as Large or Small, which can affect a number of variables in case management (processing). Project size is determined by the eligible amount as set in the damage survey

name: county
desc: The name of a U.S. county, parish, borough, independent city or other political subdivision specifying the applicant location. Counties may not be available for tribal, territories or applicants lacking specified headquarter locations.

name: countyCode
desc: Unique identifier for a U.S. county; typically, this identifier makes up the last three digits of a five digit Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) Code

name: stateAbbreviation
desc: Two-character unique identifier for a U.S. state or territory

name: stateNumberCode
desc: Unique identifier for a U.S. state or territory; this identifier makes up the first two digits of a five digit Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) Code

name: projectAmount
desc: The estimated total cost of the Public Assistance grant project in dollars, without administrative costs. This amount is based on the damage survey.

name: federalShareObligated
desc: The Public Assistance grant funding available to the grantee (State) in dollars, for sub-grantee's approved Project Worksheets

name: totalObligated
desc: The federal share of the Public Assistance grant eligible project amount in dollars, plus grantee (State) and sub-grantee (applicant) administrative costs. The federal share is typically 75% of the total cost of the project

name: mitigationAmount
desc: Public Assistance proposed amount that applies to 406 mitigation. Note: does not capture some HMP proposals in the cost lines. Some negative values may exist and are due to adjustments between mitigation costs and project costs, deobligations within versions, and incorrectly categorized mitigation cost lines.

name: lastRefresh
desc: Date the record was last updated in the API data store

name: hash
desc: MD5 Hash of the fields and values of the record

name: lastObligationDate
desc: Date the grant was last obligated

name: firstObligationDate
desc: Date the grant was initially obligated

name: gmProjectId
desc: The numeric project identification number used in GM for individual projects.

name: gmApplicantId
desc: The numeric applicant identification number used in GM that represents an applicant in a declaration.

name: projectStatus
desc: Status of the project reflecting project eligibility.
